text: Yes, I try to go running three times a week, usually early in the morning before university. I started about a year ago because I was spending far too much time sitting at my desk, and now I actually feel strange if I miss a run.

tips.en: Frequency and time of day — two details that develop the answer at once.
tips.kk: Жиілік пен уақыт — жауапты бірден дамытатын екі дерек.
tips.ru: Частота и время дня — две детали, которые сразу развивают ответ.
tips.example: three times a week, usually early in the morning

tips.en: Why it started and what changed — a mini story in two sentences.
tips.kk: Неге бастағаны және не өзгергені — екі сөйлемдегі шағын оқиға.
tips.ru: Почему начал и что изменилось — маленькая история в двух предложениях.
tips.example: I actually feel strange if I miss a run

questions.followUp: How often do you do it?
questions.question: Do you do any sport or exercise?

text: Football is probably the most popular, like in most countries, but boxing and wrestling have a huge following in Kazakhstan too, partly because we've had several world champions. In winter, lots of people go skiing in the mountains near Almaty, especially at weekends.

tips.en: From “like everywhere” to what is special at home — more interesting.
tips.kk: «Барлық жердегідей» дегеннен өз елінің ерекшелігіне — жауап қызығырақ.
tips.ru: От «как везде» к особенностям своей страны — ответ интереснее.
tips.example: boxing and wrestling have a huge following in Kazakhstan too

tips.en: Partly because explains the fact rather than just stating it.
tips.kk: Partly because деректі жай атамай, түсіндіреді.
tips.ru: Partly because объясняет факт, а не просто называет его.
tips.example: partly because we've had several world champions

questions.followUp: Do you watch sport on TV?
questions.question: What sports are popular in your country?

text: I did, yes. I played volleyball for my school team for about five years and even took part in a few city competitions. I gave it up when I started university, mostly because of a lack of time, but I still play with friends in the park every now and then.

tips.en: How long, where and what was achieved — the past sounds concrete.
tips.kk: Қанша жыл, қайда және неге жеткені — өткен нақты естіледі.
tips.ru: Сколько лет, где и чего достиг — прошлое звучит конкретно.
tips.example: even took part in a few city competitions

tips.en: Ends with the present, so the answer does not stop abruptly.
tips.kk: Қазір қалай екенімен аяқтайды — жауап үзілмейді.
tips.ru: Заканчивает тем, как сейчас, — ответ не обрывается.
tips.example: but I still play with friends in the park

note.en: A phrasal verb: stopped doing it.

questions.question: Did you play any sports when you were younger?

text: It depends on the activity. For running I prefer being alone, because it helps me clear my head and I can go at my own pace. But for anything competitive, like volleyball, I much prefer being part of a team, since the atmosphere is what makes it fun.

tips.en: It depends plus two examples with reasons — a full answer to an either-or question.
tips.kk: It depends және себептері бар екі мысал — «не-не» сұрағына толық жауап.
tips.ru: It depends и два примера с причинами — развёрнутый ответ на «или-или».

tips.en: Because and since give variety instead of repetition.
tips.kk: Because және since — қайталаудың орнына әртүрлілік.
tips.ru: Because и since — разнообразие вместо повторов.
tips.example: since the atmosphere is what makes it fun

note.en: An idiom: stop worrying and relax.
“As fast or slow as I want”.

questions.followUp: Have you ever joined a gym?
questions.question: Do you prefer exercising alone or with other people?

text: Not really, in my opinion. Most people spend hours sitting at a computer or looking at their phones, and they often say they're too busy to exercise. On the other hand, I've noticed more young people jogging and cycling in the city recently, so maybe things are slowly improving.

tips.en: The opinion is backed up at once by an everyday observation.
tips.ru: Мнение сразу подкреплено наблюдением из жизни.
tips.example: Most people spend hours sitting at a computer

tips.en: On the other hand adds an opposite observation — balanced.
tips.kk: On the other hand қарама-қарсы байқауды қосады — салмақты.
tips.ru: On the other hand добавляет противоположное наблюдение — взвешенно.
tips.example: I've noticed more young people jogging and cycling

questions.question: Do you think people do enough exercise these days?
